product.name: Monoprice LAN and Coaxial Installation Kit with Tester and Tone Generator
product.description: Are you unsure of which network tools and testers you need to order out of the myriad of options available? Get this all‑in‑one tool kit and get everything you need to build and test RJ11, RJ12, and RJ45 multiconductor cables, and RG‑58, RG‑59, and RG‑6 coaxial cables.This kit includes the complete PID 8132 MCT‑700 Tracer/Toner/Cable Tester as well as the PID 8133 LanSOHO Pro Cable Tester (no longer available separately). Additionally, the testing cables with a multimeter can be made easier using the included Black Box RJ45 breakout adapter, which gives easy access to each wire within the cable.You can prepare your multiconductor with the included stripper/cutter and your coax cables with the included PID 3359 HT‑322 Coaxial Cable Stripper/Cutters. The kit also comes with a ratcheting crimp tool, with dies for attaching RJ11, RJ45, AMP RJ45, and Coax connectors to the appropriate cables.When you need to make a keystone jack or attach LAN cables to a patch panel, you can use the included punchdown tool with the #66 and #110 punchdown/cutter dies. You can also use the included cutting pliers to cut LAN and coax cables to the proper length.The entire kit comes in an impact‑resistant plastic briefcase with foam lining and and cutouts for each tester, tool, and die, allowing you to instantly inventory the kit and identify any missing pieces before leaving a work site.Requires three 9 volt batteries, two for the MCT‑700 and another for the LanSOHO 200 (not included).Package Contents: 1x 3‑in‑1 Tracer/ Toner / Cable Tester (one 2‑piece unit)1x LanSOHO 200 Pro Cable Tester (no longer available separately)1x Multiconductor cable stripper/cutter1x Black Box RJ45 breakout adapter1x Crimp tool with ratchet action1x RJ‑45 crimping die (2 pieces)1x AMP RJ‑45 crimping die (2 pieces)1x RJ‑11 crimping die (2 pieces)1x .225/.32/.35 coax crimping die (2 pieces)1x Rotary coax cable stripper1x Cutting pliers1x Punchdown impact tool1x #66 cutter/punchdown die1x #110 cutter/punchdown die1x Instruction sheet for MCT‑700 tester1x Instruction sheet for LanSOHO 200 tester1x Instruction sheet for HT‑322 coax stripper1x Foam‑lined plastic briefcase with cutouts for each tool itemRequires three 9 volt batteries, two for the tester and another for the LanSOHO 200 (not included)Support Files: User's Manual (Aug 2, 2011)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
